---
id: env.def.covered-operations
type: definition
heading: Covered Operations
since: 1.0.0
status: draft
---

The operations described in the schedule that you, or a subcontractor on your behalf, carry out at a job site, including completed operations. They do not include operations at a covered location, or the transport of anything beyond the boundary of a job site unless [[ref:env.end.e02]] applies.
